svg.text: shaft toward you, legs pointing down
Some pots have 2 extra tabs for a
B — SAME PART ON THE SCHEMATIC
It is drawn touching the body because
that is what a wiper physically does —
it slides along the resistive track.
POT is a net label, not a dead end. The
same name reappears at U2 pin 23.
ON A BREADBOARD WITH AN UNO
Plus one 100 nF ceramic from A0 across to GND. That is the whole thing.
Buy a LINEAR pot: marked B10K or 10K LIN. An audio/log pot (A10K) works
electrically but gives a horrible speed curve — nothing, nothing, then all at once.
Value is not critical: anything from 5 k to 50 k behaves the same here.
